summary: Dirt verge on a quiet Spring Street, bush behind, houses about 25 m north.
reasons: Wide dirt verge beside narrow lane
Bush behind; house about 25 m north
Quiet residential street, one car parked

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind the verge to the west and south; an unmapped house and yard sit roughly 25 m to the north on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt verge about as wide as a van beside a narrow sealed lane; the yellow line itself runs into trees and is not usable.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with little through traffic; one car parked on the road.
drivers.convention: No signs; no clear parking convention, though a car is parked on the road.

flags: Waterway 14 m away; elevation about 5 m, possible flood-prone ground
Unmapped house about 25 m north, not in OSM buildings
Verge is narrow; check it is clear of the lane
sun_shade: Tree canopy over and behind the verge from the west; morning sun reaches the verge from the east.

best_section.where: Dirt verge at the west side of the lane, just south of the nearest yard
